summary: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with DCP > 1 starts without extra interleave flags
compatibility: No user action required; an explicit CP_KV_CACHE_INTERLEAVE_SIZE / DCP_KV_CACHE_INTERLEAVE_SIZE still wins.
details: B12X QSA shards compressed KV across DCP ranks in groups of four tokens and refused vLLM's default interleave of one ("QSA DCP requires cp_kv_cache_interleave_size divisible by 4"). The launcher now sets both interleave sizes to 4 when DCP > 1.
Together with vllm #886, TP4/DCP4 works with the official qwen4_exp checkpoints.
